g.title: LEG1
g.text: The three commitments, and where to attack them
The clock is cumulative mechanical work.
Follow the bold violet spine: EX_DOSE → σ → (σ)⁴ → ID_STRAIN.
Genotype enters at exactly one edge (DESMO_RESERVE ⊣ FATIGUE). Age is not a variable anywhere.
PHI_EX = 0. Damage becomes load-independent, and exercise dose-response, incomplete
penetrance, gene-elusive ARVC, RV selectivity and the Fabritz load-reduction result all disappear at once.
Two measured numbers do it: +125% RV vs +14% LV wall stress on exercise.
No RV-specific biology is used. KAPPA_LV — the one chamber-specific term — is ON only for DSP/FLNC.
Two generators, and a drug cannot outperform the one it occupies.
exists before any structural change; brown cluster 10 is scar re-entry. Every drug in cluster 17 is drawn
onto a specific node, which is why FLECAINIDE has an arrow into each generator with opposite sign, why
SOTALOL's two arrows cancel, and why the ICD's only arrow is into the outcome.
solid = activation/flux · dashed with a bar = inhibition · bold violet = the fatigue clock ·
dotted = a switch that is off unless the genotype or the scenario turns it on.
octagon = an intervention point or an exposure · double octagon = a load-bearing claim ·
ellipse = an ODE state variable in arvc_mrgsolve_model.R · hexagon = a switch parameter · note = a stated limit.
penetrance, gene-elusive ARVC, RV-before-LV, load-reduction efficacy, the sotalol null, flecainide's sign
flip, the endo-vs-epi ablation gap, the ICD's outcome-only benefit, and gene-therapy timing.
